prompts.sujinFront: Use case: identity-preserve game character production reference. Create ONE full-body STRAIGHT FRONT VIEW of the EXACT SAME SUJIN character in the supplied image, in the SAME stylized tactile 3D cartoon rendering. Her head, torso, hips, feet and gaze all face directly toward camera, not three-quarter, no tilted head or contrapposto. Keep her recognizable facial design and proportions, short side-parted brown bob silhouette, small gold round earrings, teal textured blazer, cream knit top, charcoal wide-leg ankle-length trousers, brown loafers, reddish hardback study book. Cute gentle intelligent adult Korean friend, approachable and attentive. Simple modeled cartoon eyes with clean modest ivory sclera, dark-brown iris/pupil shapes, minimal highlight; NOT realistic eyes, no iris fibers, no detailed eyelash hairs, no skin pores or glass doll stare. Eye corners and brows relaxed, slightly softer/flatter than reference, not sharply lifted or stern. Adult proportions same as reference, no child proportions. Neutral friendly small closed-mouth smile. Straight standing front pose with shoulders level, both feet evenly planted, one arm calmly holding the SAME reddish book against lower torso, free arm relaxed beside body with hand visible. Preserve shape language and outfit precisely; no redesign or extra accessory. Warm light ivory seamless background, soft studio lighting, gentle grounded contact shadow, entire head and both shoes visible with margins. High resolution portrait. No extra views, no text, no labels, no UI, no photo rendering. This is a character-sheet reference candidate for later consistent expressions and poses.

Same tactile 3D cartoon quality and soft warm studio lighting. One clean professionally spaced sheet on uniform light ivory background, no captions/numbers/labels/text/UI or decorative borders. All figures belong to the SAME CHARACTER MODEL, consistent scale and rendering. Keep clear gaps, no overlap/cropping. Expression sheet, landscape 3:2 composition, SIX evenly sized head-and-shoulders portraits arranged exactly3columns x2rows. Row1 left: neutral attentive gentle small smile; center: delighted friendly laugh, eyes softly crescent-shaped, modest open mouth; right: curious thoughtful, small head tilt only, relaxed eyebrows, no steep villain brow. Row2 left: pleasantly surprised, brows gently lifted, small rounded open mouth, no bulging eyes; center: compassionate concerned, brows mildly drawn inward, reassuring soft mouth, no anger/blame; right: encouraging confident warm smile with a subtle nod, friendly eye contact. Expressions distinct but moderate and suitable for adult learner story dialogue. Correct anatomy, only six portraits, generous face resolution.
